rules: Reference fixture names, dates, owners and totals are never inserted into runtime state or API payloads.

Reference-image discrepancies never create per-window color exceptions. Repeated semantic icons resolve through shared VST families.
All trash/delete icons continue to resolve through the canonical --cf-vst-color-delete family.
No fake success, automatic merge, silent fallback, unapproved browser mutation or production merge was introduced.
